result.keyword: What's the best project management tool for a startup?
result.markdown:
For most startups, I'd recommend **ClickUp or Linear**, depending on what you're building and how your team operates.

My overall advice: choose something that is easy to adopt, affordable, and can grow with your business. Don't introduce enterprise-level project management when you have a team of five.

## My top 5 project management tools for startups

![Cycles are here! – Changelog](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/z73iGvyFXFGNNHzf108J4q2-MAH4OSEY9mbfIxv1JkRozOiXQPuXG-KTsoWStom_ZT4fDx-cfOrVWY65khCMFDbJHVOOy3Bwf1mRGwcya0X2rZziCCmCXUSxqc7o-5e7Yz_ySynpKNSox6ImcWQisOrU7FTcdJ7TUL22dpMLPS3PRCaMchc3PJxFNjMWsdFY?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Linear**

(Best for tech startups)

- Excellent product and engineering workflows.
- Clean, fast interface.
- Great for managing bugs, features and development sprints.
- Integrates with GitHub.

**My pick\:** SaaS and software startups.

[Explore Linear](https://linear.app/)

---

![Finastra Customer Story | ClickUp™](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/OXxUksa73j7hoTxbYQ6zo3pspX36GflPBLMsRWXjhfWZTJdFq6md_tXaxCCc_3Kjh0xQSrUSgXoCYi3d5TOe48r-mvzFwLplQbgf4lhsH3q_bsATt_hAcyva5qI1DtZG8OasgRxxldReZAIfURcJdNdt2Br8nPVvqn-lCO5aR2MxpFl9QAiCxibf4gzehOOb?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. ClickUp**

(Best all-rounder)

- Tasks, projects, documents and goals.
- Dashboards and reporting.
- Automations and custom workflows.
- Can manage almost the entire business in one place.

**My pick\:** Startups wanting one central operating system.

[Explore ClickUp](https://clickup.com/)

---

![Project Management Hub Template by Gridvio | Notion Marketplace](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/6e1oG6Y_aW5V5yDl222hE8Y8t-T__05L0OPLqrtY2b6KrmvS_M-QH4eaVLv4afPJUAGCFGr_eoifL-Irt3_HiUqUmKW08dRjhIxW2MfVWL_nPAWNaujkMp5zdq2VbJkW7b3h6jvrTVNAFmmVU9MPLCBztqWrhslDc_LeRhpbcV451et11onvlpgBLkBnIYcR?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Notion**

(Best for early-stage startups)

- Project management and company wiki.
- Meeting notes and documentation.
- Product roadmaps and task databases.
- Highly flexible.

**My pick\:** Small founding teams that need to organise everything.

[Explore Notion](https://www.notion.com/)

---

![Show tasks and milestones per project in Portfolio Timeline - Product Feedback - Asana Forum](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/WdbzrV3coAvJm-GewoC9GUVfJkq8C2TMbblEQvOx15prYXK1dOVkjrDVYAgw0KBZMGXFs9retNvetWxcuET-bGnlQaiBAT7rSMwCTcYBnWLu2-nxTqvSwhmbG6_UmXEy4KOaoWdxi7bX62AlUNzYyu7wGMyODlO-fsAyrwEwsCY7wGGgmlfx660ByC5Pht0D?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Asana**

- Excellent task ownership and accountability.
- Project timelines and dependencies.
- Good cross-team collaboration.
- Useful as departments grow.

**My pick\:** Startups with product, marketing, sales and operations teams.

[Explore Asana](https://asana.com/)

---

![Monday Vibe | Build Custom Apps with Vibe Coding & AI Prompts](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/dZbPOy2ExCYPWkRUN-y8aNBArPHAy5RJyF2Fv3kOH8r0onm7GzQMtNgFLnlF_orijMr1L_hlS3rZ5CmII7wcg1sC5QIg6R8JlCgddpaNU2x9UGq4FrFp6DOJXu4JvN0TyREqPyEMky1tg6L3RhInST4tHJiMa0BGxgH61Ibvrnb8NABR1soD10zbitKXa9pg?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. monday.com**

- Very visual project dashboards.
- Custom workflows and automations.
- Good reporting and integrations.
- Easy for non-technical teams to understand.

**My pick\:** Startups with lots of operational processes.

[Explore monday.com](https://monday.com/)

These recommendations reflect current 2026 comparisons of startup project management platforms. ## Quick comparison

| Tool | Best suited for | Complexity |
|--------|--------|--------|
| Linear | Product & engineering | Low |
| ClickUp | Whole business | Medium |
| Notion | Founders & documentation | Low–Medium |
| Asana | Cross-functional teams | Medium |
| monday.com | Operations & workflows | Medium |


## What I'd choose at different startup stages

- **1–3 people\:** Notion or Trello.
- **4–15 people\:** Linear + Notion, or ClickUp.
- **15–50 people\:** ClickUp or Asana.
- **50+ people\:** Asana, Linear and specialist tools depending on departments.

## Let me narrow it down to the best option

There are three things that would change my recommendation.

E-commerce

Consulting / Agency

Other / General business
